patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Coralogix and Sentry share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Coralogix and Sentry share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Coralogix only if your buying job matches “Observability usage rate card — Logs $0.42/GB, Traces $0.16/GB, Metrics $0.06/GB, AI $1.50” rather than Sentry's shape. Choose Sentry only if your buying job matches “Application error monitoring, tracing, and replays — Developer Free; Team $26/mo annual wi” rather than Coralogix's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Coralogix is shaped for Observability usage rate card — Logs $0.42/GB, Traces $0.16/GB, Metric whereas Sentry is shaped for Application error monitoring, tracing, and replays — Developer Free; T. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Coralogix and Sentry share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Coralogix is Observability usage rate card — Logs $0.42/GB, Traces $0.16/GB, Metrics $0.06/GB, AI $1.50/1M tokens; 14-day / 8-unit trial. No seat floor. ; Sentry is Application error monitoring, tracing, and replays — Developer Free; Team $26/mo annual with default prepaid; Business $80/mo. Not a Datadog.
- Company-size focus: Coralogix (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Sentry (solo, micro, small-business).
- Researched limits: Coralogix — Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); Sentry — Not a Datadog-style infrastructure monitoring suite — errors/traces/replays are the job.

Limitations — Coralogix: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); No published seat floor — GB/token math still dominates TCO; Sentry: Not a Datadog-style infrastructure monitoring suite — errors/traces/replays are the job; Prepaid event volume on Team/Business is the TCO lever beyond $26/$80 stickers.

Poor-fit cases: Coralogix is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6) · Sentry is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a Datadog-style infrastructure monitoring suite — errors/traces/replays are the job · Avoid Coralogix if you actually need Sentry's motion (Application error monitoring, tracing, and replays — Developer Free; Team $26/mo)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
